headline: Police arrest Tamil Nadu BJP chief amid tight Thirupparankundram lamp security
summary: Madurai police declared Thirupparankundram Hill a red zone on November 24 after the Supreme Court ordered a one-time Karthigai Deepam lighting at the Deepathoon pillar. Police arrested Tamil Nadu BJP chief Nainar Nagenthran near Tirunelveli and stopped L. Murugan in Coimbatore to prevent unauthorised access near the hilltop dargah.
why_it_matters: Managing shared sacred sites with competing claims tests state law enforcement and political restraint when judicial interim orders coincide with major religious festivals.
source_search: Police arrest Tamil Nadu BJP chief amid tight Thirupparankundram lamp security The Hindu

headline: NATO vows space defence over reports of Russian nuclear satellite
summary: NATO chief Mark Rutte pledged to defend allied space assets after German media reported intelligence warning Russia may launch a nuclear-armed satellite, Sputnik-S, within 60 days. Moscow dismissed the claims, which would breach the 1967 Outer Space Treaty and threaten over 15,000 active satellites vital for communications and navigation.
why_it_matters: Deploying nuclear weapons in orbit could indiscriminately cripple military communications, surveillance, and navigation infrastructure across more than 15,000 satellites, including Russia's own.
source_search: NATO vows space defence over reports of Russian nuclear satellite BBC

headline: Over 2.36 million overage vehicles still run in Delhi-NCR: CAQM
summary: The Commission for Air Quality Management told the Supreme Court that over 2.36 million end-of-life vehicles still operate across Delhi-NCR. Across four NCR states, only 1.85 lakh of 2.54 million overage vehicles have been scrapped or cleared, alongside November 1 Delhi entry bans on older buses and goods vehicles.
why_it_matters: High-emitting legacy vehicles severely undermine urban clean-air efforts, showing that entry restrictions on commercial fleets cannot offset slow scrapping of private two-wheelers and cars.
source_search: Over 2.36 million overage vehicles still run in Delhi-NCR: CAQM The Hindu

headline: Malaysia to deport over 6,500 Rohingya refugees back to Myanmar
summary: Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim told parliament Tuesday that Malaysia will return over 6,500 Rohingya refugees to Myanmar in December via navy ships and aircraft. The plan follows last week's International Court of Justice genocide ruling against Myanmar, as Malaysia cites financial strain and security risks from hosting refugees.
why_it_matters: Returning thousands of refugees to a war-torn state after reports of earlier returnees facing military detention exposes deep tensions between regional asylum fatigue and human rights obligations.
source_search: Malaysia to deport over 6,500 Rohingya refugees back to Myanmar Al Jazeera

headline: Centre cites citizenship loss over Indian-origin fighter in Russian Army
summary: The Union government told the Supreme Court on November 23 that it has limited scope to repatriate an Indian-origin man serving in Russia's Army because he acquired Russian nationality. Solicitor General Tushar Mehta assured Chief Justice Surya Kant's bench that India will still explore humanitarian options to help him.
why_it_matters: Cases of students recruited into foreign armies expose legal limits on diplomatic rescue once citizens surrender Indian passports, with 24 Indians still serving in Russia.
source_search: Centre cites citizenship loss over Indian-origin fighter in Russian Army The Hindu

headline: Australia threatens tech giants with 5% global revenue fines over harm
summary: Australia unveiled a digital duty-of-care bill Tuesday proposing fines up to 5% of worldwide revenue on firms like Google and Meta that fail to stop harmful content. Expected to pass Parliament this week, the law lets individuals sue platforms and lets users aged 16 or older turn off algorithmic feeds.
why_it_matters: Tying penalties to global turnover following Australia's under-16 social media ban creates a tough regulatory template that could force major platforms to redesign moderation worldwide.
source_search: Australia threatens tech giants with 5% global revenue fines over harm Al Jazeera

headline: Kerala High Court grants bail and protection to LTTE case approver
summary: The Kerala High Court granted bail to Sri Lankan national Muhammed Asmin, an accused in a transnational conspiracy to revive the LTTE, after a special NIA court pardoned him to become a prosecution approver. Judges also directed the state Home Department to protect him under the Kerala Witness Protection Scheme.
why_it_matters: Safeguarding key witnesses who turn approvers in transnational security trials is vital for securing convictions when testimonies carry severe personal risks of retaliation.
source_search: Kerala High Court grants bail and protection to LTTE case approver The Hindu

headline: Suspected gas blast at Hanoi eatery kills six, injures over fourteen
summary: A suspected early-morning gas explosion at a crowded hot pot restaurant in Hanoi killed six people and hospitalised more than 14 on Tuesday, November 24. The blast collapsed roofs, damaged neighbouring homes, and forced authorities to evacuate nearby unsafe apartment buildings while rescue teams searched rubble for trapped survivors.
why_it_matters: Deadly commercial gas leaks in dense urban neighbourhoods expose recurring gaps in building safety inspections and emergency compliance across rapidly growing Asian cities.
source_search: Suspected gas blast at Hanoi eatery kills six, injures over fourteen The Hindu

headline: BJP and Akali Dal revive Punjab alliance after six-year split
summary: The BJP and Shiromani Akali Dal reunited on Tuesday to contest the 2027 Punjab assembly elections together, ending a six-year split over repealed farm laws. Amit Shah, BJP chief Nitin Nabin, and SAD leader Sukhbir Singh Badal announced the NDA reunion after winning just five seats combined in 2022.
why_it_matters: Rebuilding one of India's oldest regional alliances gives the NDA a stronger foothold in Punjab's 117-member assembly after failed 2024 Lok Sabha seat-sharing talks.
source_search: BJP and Akali Dal revive Punjab alliance after six-year split Hindustan Times

headline: CJP leader Saurav Das alleges Delhi airport immigration barred UK travel
summary: Cockroach Janta Party co-convener Saurav Das alleged on November 23 that Delhi airport immigration officials stopped him from boarding a 1 a.m. flight to London. Das claimed his passport was flagged to block him from speaking on the cockroach movement at Oxford University, blaming the Modi government for the restriction.
why_it_matters: Allegations of unexplained immigration flags against political activists travelling for university talks raise fresh scrutiny over transparency in India's airport travel restrictions.
source_search: CJP leader Saurav Das alleges Delhi airport immigration barred UK travel The Hindu

headline: DR Congo plane missing as rebels claim shootdown in South Kivu
summary: The Democratic Republic of Congo's military is searching for a Cessna 208 missing since Sunday as FRN rebels claim they shot down a warplane near Minembwe and captured Ugandan and South African crew. Uganda denied involvement on Monday, while intensifying fighting disrupts medical charities and traps Ebola response workers.
why_it_matters: Escalating clashes involving alleged foreign mercenaries in eastern Congo threaten to paralyse humanitarian aid and worsen containment of an active Ebola outbreak.
source_search: DR Congo plane missing as rebels claim shootdown in South Kivu BBC

headline: Trump faces backlash over claims he pushed Nvidia to reinstate Huang
summary: US President Donald Trump and Nvidia face lawmaker backlash after Trump told CNBC he convinced the chipmaker's board to reinstate CEO Jensen Huang on Monday. Huang had resigned on November 12 over an affair with a suspected Chinese spy; his return added nearly $1 trillion to Nvidia's market value.
why_it_matters: Presidential intervention in a major listed company's leadership amid an ongoing espionage investigation blurs lines between national security governance and corporate autonomy ahead of congressional hearings.
source_search: Trump faces backlash over claims he pushed Nvidia to reinstate Huang BBC
